fullPassage: The Blue Ridge YMCA is proud to announce its upcoming gently used sports equipment drive, Gear Up for Good. Let's level the playing field and help more kids play sports this year! Donate Gear: July 7 – July 21. Bring your new or gently used sports equipment to the Blue Ridge YMCA, Cedar Creek Family YMCA, or Harbor Point Family YMCA. We Accept Equipment for: Baseball, Basketball, Soccer, Tennis, Swimming, Golf, Yoga, Surfing, Boxing, Bikes, Skateboards, Cheerleading. *Note: We do not accept sports clothing or swimwear. Shop the Sale: July 25 (2 PM – 5 PM). All donated sports equipment will be available for purchase at the Blue Ridge YMCA. Community members are invited to shop the sale for affordable, quality sports gear! VOLUNTEER! We are looking for volunteers to help organize donations and prepare for the sale. Volunteers must sign up on our official website.
